If you are submitting an EOB or MyChart (or equivalent), please make sure you include the following within your submitted documentation:
  1. Full name
  2. DOB
  3. Services completed
  4. Service completion date
  5. If you need credit for the biometric activities, please submit your biometric screening results.
  6. Submit your age/gender preventive screening forms through the activity form titled "Age/Gender Screenings Form".
  7. Make sure you are submitting your own personal forms. Spouses have their own accounts.
  8. Make sure you are only submitting the pages that show the proof needed above (no extra pages).
By submitting this document, you authorize the release of all personal health information included on the document to Prevention Cloud. Your information will not be shared with Pepperl + Fuchs and will only be used and accessed by Prevention Cloud
